articles.title: Mexican billionaire with 70% of his investment portfolio in bitcoin says it's better than real estate
articles.snippet: Ricardo Salinas Pliego, whose net worth is estimated at roughly $5 billion, is a bitcoin maximalist who told his wife to mortgage her house to buy bitcoin.

articles.title: Bitcoin's June downturn leaves $8.6 billion in options out of the money
articles.snippet: Only 20% of June 26 options open interest is currently in the money, while bitcoin's 12% monthly decline leaves most bullish positions underwater.

articles.title: Hyperliquid's $10B open interest coincides with growth in equity-linked markets: Talos
articles.snippet: Hyperliquid’s $10 billion open interest milestone shows growing demand for onchain equities and commodities trading with 24/7 accessibility, according to Talos.

articles.title: Congress reaches deal on housing bill with CBDC ban until 2030
articles.snippet: The US could soon temporarily ban a central bank digital currency, as House and Senate leaders came to a deal on the 21st Century Road to Housing Act.

articles.title: Florida Man 'Bitcoin Rodney' Pleads Guilty Over $1.8 Billion HyperFund Crypto Fraud
articles.snippet: A Miami-based man who went by the name “Bitcoin Rodney” pleaded guilty for his role in what prosecutors said was a massive global fraud.
